description:
Outcome: Gardeners sign in by emailed one-time link (owner decision); contacts remain coordinator-only (brief.md: Constraints)
Scope: Request/redeem links; sessions/signout; household association; coordinator administration; unknown emails enter pending registration for coordinator validation before applying. Excludes: Passwords and social login
Acceptance: Expiring hashed single-use tokens; safe redirects; request rate limits and neutral responses; no contact data in gardener responses, markup or logs; only own records accessible; coordinator role cannot be self-assigned
Behaviour: Accessible mobile loading/error states; expired/used link retry and delivery recovery without account enumeration
Verification: Expiry, replay, concurrent redemption, cross-household authorization and fake-mail end-to-end tests. Prerequisites: T-001, T-002. Assumptions: Initial coordinator bootstrapped out of band; explain pending registration clearly
title: Passwordless sign-in and role privacy
